scope: Local CPU-only flat-floor single MicroDuck goal navigation; frozen pretrained gait, PPO navigation trained from random initialization
note: PPO rounds the budget up to a complete rollout (4 × 256 steps).

acceptance.selection: validation success rate, then validation return; never holdout

limitations: One training seed; repeated seeds replayed during implementation are not additional independent samples.
No obstacles, vision, physical robot, object grasp, or transport.
1000000-step duration is an extrapolation, not a convergence guarantee.
Videos and model checkpoint binaries stay in ignored local runs/; this report preserves metrics.
